title: Add host-utilization endpoints to the architecture route tables
outcome: The architecture route inventory matches the implemented local, Central aggregate and authenticated pair utilization endpoints and their error outcomes.
acceptance: List GET /api/host-utilization, GET /api/federation/host-utilization and GET /federation/v1/host-utilization in the appropriate architecture route tables.
Describe the applicable 409 and 503 outcomes consistently with the implementation and feature brief.
Source review confirms documentation consistency without inventing execution, health or transport authority.
